mapper.select: SELECT asset_id, project_id, name, asset_type, role FROM asset WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY asset_id
SELECT i.ip_id, i.asset_id, i.address, i.ip_type, i.phase, i.ext_whitelisted FROM asset_ip i JOIN asset a ON a.asset_id = i.asset_id WHERE a.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY i.ip_id
SELECT dependency_id, project_id, from_asset_id, to_asset_id, target_address, target_port, protocol, config_location FROM dependency WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY dependency_id

SELECT r.rule_id, r.rule_code, f.code AS factor_code, f.weight AS factor_weight, r.title, r.severity, r.occurrence, r.detection, r.is_blocking AS blocking, r.message_template, r.mitigation FROM risk_rule r JOIN risk_factor f ON f.factor_id = r.factor_id WHERE r.enabled = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagnosis_run (project_id, total_score, risk_level, blocked, finding_count) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{totalScore}, #{riskLevel}, #{blocked}, #{findingCount})

INSERT INTO diagnosis_finding (run_id, rule_id, asset_id, dependency_id, rpn, detail) VALUES
(#{f.runId}, #{f.ruleId}, #{f.assetId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{f.dependencyId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{f.rpn}, #{f.detail})
